meta.description: A boutique hair salon in Portland, OR. Signature cut $65. Book in one tap.

hero.headline:
Hair that feels
like you.
hero.lede: No assembly-line blowouts. A stylist who studies your face shape, your routine, and how much time you actually have in the morning.
hero.card_lg: Cut once, love it for months

why.title: Not every chair is the same.
why.sub: Chain salons sell speed. We sell the cut you stop thinking about — because it grows out right.

cards.title: Face-shape first
cards.desc: Every visit starts with a 10-minute consult on your face shape, hair texture, and routine — then we cut.

cards.title: One stylist, start to finish
cards.desc: No hand-offs to juniors. The stylist who consults you washes, cuts, and finishes you.

cards.title: A calm, unhurried room
cards.desc: Six chairs, never double-booked. Your appointment time is actually yours.

items.quote: First salon where the cut still looked good six weeks later. The consult is not a gimmick — she noticed things about my hair I never had.
items.name: Rachel T.

items.quote: As a curly girl I've been burned everywhere. They cut it dry, curl by curl. Never going anywhere else.
items.name: Maya L.

items.quote: Balayage came out exactly like the photos we discussed. Zero brassiness two months in.
items.name: Jess K.
